blurb: Senator William Andrews Clark-copper magnate, railroad baron, and one of the richest men of the Gilded Age-bought the United Verde Copper Company mine in Jerome in 1888. When he decided to move his smelter further downhill in 1912, he planned and built Clarkdale to house his workers. Arizona's first company town, it included residences, a business district, a hospital, schools, and a town park.
